g.text: Flink: one run, lock to done-marker
unpack; verify sha256 and record count
Three jobs in sequence: apply, wait for FINISHED, delete
clear target rows and map/schema rejects
A FAILED job, or no FINISHED in ~10 min,
exits 1 with no done-marker. The next firing retries.
run, with src_read from the producer's .CHS
batches of 200; replace the run_ledger row
exit 0 only if balanced and none unconfirmed
